lessons_used: Reordering steps, adding an estimated countdown on wait screens, pet control tutorial screens, and personality-driven copy improved performance.
Bypassing onboarding steps yielded mixed results, winning in one test but significantly hurting in another.
Major redesigns, account recovery safety hints, and companion benefit story copy significantly hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, permission checks, incentives, guide screens, and most wait info or copy updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions generally overestimated actual gains, but underestimated performance for the pet control tutorial screen, countdown wait info, and personality-driven headlines.

candidates.title: Sign-in mode selection layout redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the sign-in screen into a centered layout with choice card components clearly separating account login methods to reduce sign-in drop-off and session resets.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 76.1% and 8 support emails (the top complaint theme) reported pets missing or reset after logging into the wrong account.

sign_in_options.text: Sign in with existing pet profile or create a new desktop account

guard.reason: replacement for 'sign_in.sign_in_options' does not do the job (a sign-in button that says so): needs 1 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Photo style preset selection screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen before photo upload allowing users to pick a visual rendering style (3D, Pixel, Anime) for their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.3% and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or producing incorrect visual results.

new_photo_style.headline: Choose Visual Render Style
new_photo_style.body: Select your preferred art style before generating your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Adding a visual style preset selection screen inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off and support tickets confirm issue, but extra screens have mixed results.

candidates.title: Desktop pet generation waiting room redesign
candidates.change: Transform the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring an explicit progress timer component to keep users engaged while assets render.
candidates.why: The waiting step (home target step) suffers from a long median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs and lost attention.

wait_status.text: Generating desktop pet animations and sound profiles...

guard.reason: 'waiting.replace.wait_status[0]': timer text must read like 'About 4 min left' (at most 30 min)

candidates.title: Desktop visibility check sub-flow screen
candidates.change: Add a new setup confirmation screen at the end of onboarding that presents a checklist verifying pet visibility and control menu access.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or failing to open, and 3 emails reported confusion around controlling or hiding the pet.

new_visibility_check.headline: Confirm Desktop Pet Rendering
new_visibility_check.body: Check that your companion appears on your screen and your system tray menu is active.

components.text: Pet rendered on screen; Tray controls accessible; Interaction active

guard.reason: Adding a setup confirmation screen after home_intro is allowed as part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence and pet control tutorial screens previously improved performance.

candidates.title: Story screen mascot story scroll layout
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story screen using a story_scroll layout with a friendly mascot component to introduce the app concept.
candidates.why: The initial path selection step has a 78.7% conversion and a high mean time of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Companion path selection duration hint
candidates.change: Add a visual hint on the choose_path screen clarifying that path selection takes less than 2 minutes.
candidates.why: Users take a mean of 514s on choose_path with a 78.7% conversion rate, showing hesitation early in the funnel.

choose_path.hint: Path setup takes under 2 minutes. You can customize companion traits anytime later.

guard.reason: Adding a path setup duration hint is permitted and compliant with fair design.

candidates.score_note: Address high step duration, but hint changes on earlier steps have shown neutral or negative impact.

candidates.title: Photo upload clarity and quality guidance
candidates.change: Update headline and body on upload_photos screen to give explicit advice on lighting and front-facing pet photos.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation output looking wrong or failing, contributing to the 69.3% adoption step completion.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear, Front-Facing Photos
upload_photos.body: For accurate 3D desktop pet rendering, use well-lit photos showing your pet facing the camera directly.

guard.reason: Updating guidance copy on the photo upload screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High drop adoption step backed by support tickets; low-cost copy change.

candidates.title: Home welcome checklist layout overhaul
candidates.change: Switch the home_intro screen to a checklist layout detailing core pet actions like dragging, minimizing, and summoning.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 71.6% and support received multiple tickets asking how to hide, summon, or talk to their pet after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Desktop Pet Controls Checklist
home_intro.body: Quickly review how to interact with your pet on your desktop toolbar and screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro screen into a checklist layout remains within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish layout tweaks and pet control instructions consistently yield positive lift.

candidates.title: Desktop background ready sound chime
candidates.change: Enable background notifications and add an explicit sound component trigger on the waiting screen when pet generation finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has an average time of 2336s, suggesting users minimize the desktop app during generation and forget to switch back.

guard.reason: Adding completion chime and notifications to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: High duration step, but notification changes historically showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Account sync safety hint on sign in
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users to sign in with their existing credentials to prevent progress resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (highest count) complained about pets disappearing or resetting after logging in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your primary account to preserve your desktop pet species, items, and companion memory.

guard.reason: Adding an account sync hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High support volume, but account recovery safety hints significantly hurt performance in past tests.

picked: Photo upload clarity and quality guidance
Account sync safety hint on sign in

decisions.title: Photo upload clarity and quality guidance
Account sync safety hint on sign in

shipped: Account sync safety hint on sign in
lessons_next: Reordering steps, estimated wait countdowns, pet tutorial screens, personality-driven headlines, path duration hints, and account sync safety hints improved performance.
Bypassing onboarding steps yielded mixed results (winning once, but hurting significantly in another test).
Major redesigns, companion benefit story copy, photo guidance copy, and account recovery safety hints significantly hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, incentives, guide screens, permission checks, and most wait info or copy updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions generally overestimated gains across most tests, particularly for redesigns, guide screens, and copy changes.
Predictions underestimated performance for pet control tutorial screens, wait countdowns, personality-driven headlines, path duration hints, and account sync safety hints.
